long_biography.plain_text:
PHMG began in a tiny Manchester office in 1998 around the idea that sound could change how businesses communicate. Over more than a quarter-century it expanded from music-on-hold into audio branding, content, cloud telephony and customer-experience services for almost 40,000 clients. Jason Peter Clarke held a substantial share of the business during that international expansion.

In April 2025, PHMG moved into employee ownership. Clarke's controlling interest ended as the employee trust took control, marking a clear transition from private shareholding to institutional stewardship. His long-held stake in PHMG was distinct from his earlier controlling interest in CVS. That commercial-rates consultancy passed to Altus Group after becoming a major adviser to UK businesses.
